selected_result: Theorem 2.4: high-probability bound for a signed product of independent rounding factors

bibliographic_source.title: A New Approach to Probabilistic Rounding Error Analysis

paper_locations.section: 2, probabilistic bound for product of rounding errors

task_clarification: For n independent random variables delta_i of mean zero with |delta_i|<=u, and an arbitrary choice rho_i in {-1,+1}, define the signed product R=product_i (1+delta_i)^rho_i.
Assume a valid positive unit roundoff u<1 and lambda>0. The paper defines gammaTilde_n(lambda)=exp(lambda*u*sqrt(n)+n*u^2/(1-u))-1 and P(lambda)=1-2*exp(-lambda^2*(1-u)^2/2).
The event |R-1|<=gammaTilde_n(lambda) has probability at least P(lambda). The same event must cover the entire signed product, not merely each factor separately.
scope_constraints: Retain independence, zero mean, boundedness, all choices of signs, lambda>0, and the exact source constants.
Do not replace the probabilistic conclusion with the deterministic gamma_n bound or a first-order approximation.
Do not assume the target product inequality or its probability as a field of the random-variable model.
